author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
A (fancy) remake of Volcano by {tag=d0ef13b757a84d11bd37ba15aa8311f6}.

It features: 
- Symmetrical sides
- Armor caves
- Four (non) obsidian monuments
- A max capacity of 32 players



There may be a 2nd Volcano map with the other cut of the land on the other map! Look for that one possibly releasing soon.
